Z drugiej projekty takie jak Ripple konsekwentnie pozyskują licencje na kluczowych rynkach azjatyckich. XRP poczyniło kolejny duży krok w rozwoju – Ripple ze zgodą od Singapuru na rozwój regulowanych usług płatniczych!

articles.description:
Authorities across Europe have shut down a crypto-mixing service "Cryptomixer",  
allegedly used by cybercriminals to launder Bitcoin,  
seizing millions in crypto, critical servers, and terabytes of data. 
Between November 24 and 28, 2025, law enforcement  
agencies from Switzerland and Germany, coordinated by Europol, targeted  
Cryptomixer, alleged to have laundered over €1.3  
billion ($1.51 billion) in Bitcoin since 2016. 
According to Europol, authorities confiscated three  
servers, the platform’s domain, more than €25 million ($29 million) in BTC, and  
over 12 terabytes of operational data.
